population: all rollout episodes (policy_repo_id non-empty) of the two design-frozen pilot tasks from meta/episodes: cable_clip + fold_tea_towel

estimands.C: success_rate = mean(success == 1) per task x policy over all rollout episodes
estimands.B_primary: success_rate_at_horizon = mean((success == 1) AND (length <= L50_task)); episode label is ground truth (no re-judging); successes were trimmed at completion (2611.03168 section 5) so success lands at the episode end
estimands.B_frozen_labels_audit: mean(success == 1) on unchanged membership (= C by construction), reported to audit the 'labels stay episode labels' clause
estimands.A: task-only fallback layers; per-cell n>=10 gate; layer kept with >=2 participating policies; layer rate = in-layer success rate; global aggregate weighted by layer episode count

structural_checks.note: expected by construction under batch_axis=unavailable_task_fallback and frozen episode labels; recorded as measured facts (max abs diffs above)
